method.quote: Payer shall reimburse Covered Services at the fixed amounts per unit of service stated in Exhibit A.

flags.quote: Section 2.3. Adjustments: the multiple procedure payment reduction applies; the assistant reduction does not apply; sequestration does not apply; NCCI edits apply; timed units are counted under the Medicare pooled 8-minute rule.

rounding.quote: Section 2.2. All payment amounts are rounded half up to the nearest cent.

effective_from.quote: This Agreement is effective 15 January 2026 and continues until either party ends it on 90 days written notice.
